purpose: Discover public Wayback captures of the IBKR usa.txt publisher feed specifically in the 39 currently missing calendar months, before opening any archived raw snapshot bytes.
allowed_outputs: distinct snapshot metadata deduplicated by target+snapshot timestamp+URL
snapshot-month membership relative to the 39 missing months
forbidden: download or open any archived usa.txt byte
open FEERATE, AVAILABLE or any economic value
select additional dates based on discovered contents
use credentials, API keys or account login
successor_rule: For each distinct archived raw snapshot whose timestamp or original URL plausibly maps to a missing month, freeze exact-snapshot raw preflight before opening bytes. No snapshot is admitted from availability metadata alone.
